title: animated sprites
shortDescription: Frame-based sprite animation with an AnimatedSprites mesh, its animation declared in the texture catalog
description: Up to 3000 sprites in one `AnimatedSprites` mesh, each a vertex object of the `AnimatedSpritesGeometry` with an `animId` of its own. A `TextureStore` loads `nobingers.json`, which declares the texture, the `TileSet` and the animation `anim0` — eight tiles at 12 fps — in one place, and `getAsync()` hands back the texture and the `FrameBasedAnimations`. The animations are baked into a data texture for the `AnimatedSpritesMaterial`, which plays them on the GPU from `material.time`. The *more* and *less* buttons create and free sprites in the pool while the demo runs.
